note: CEO 2026-10-01. A team is an execution island: ONE persistent Claude session that runs seats as subagents inside itself. Teams are generic, not per project — one request may cross the design system and the app in one island when the work has a dependency. Seats are a shared pool: a seat runs in at most one team at a time (seat_reservation), and a team borrows a free seat rather than waiting. One Codex Listener conversation controls every team. Teams are named after temples, as seats are named after deities (NAMING.csv).
